A '''Jedi investigator''' was the a specialization that could be attained by those [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] studying the ways of the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]].

==Overview==
Working as agents to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], these individuals were highly certified to work with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] in tracking down criminals and uncovering hidden and obscure threats to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Appointed by the Council, Jedi investigators were charged with rooting out threats via their detective skills and [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]]. While the presence of the Investigator within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had remained a relative constant, it wasn't until after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] that the role was clearly defined in ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''; the section on investigators was authored by the [[Jedi Seer]] [[Sabla-Mandibu]].<ref name="TJP" />

[[File:Trouble_in_the_Hold_EV.png|thumb|left|250px|A [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] Jedi investigator scrutinizes a murder scene.]]
Often times, the work of the investigators led them to working completely independent of official agencies as they went deep undercover, infiltrating the organization under suspicion, and using guile, deception or even force in addition to detective skills to achieve their goal. Working from within, Jedi investigators were often successful in neutralizing the enemy before galactic conflict could arise. Jedi investigators would also [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on known criminal syndicates, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups, [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] organizations as well as individual criminals and report their findings to the Council, which kept detailed record of most known criminals in the galaxy through their connection to the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Galactic City Police's]] criminal archives.<ref name="TJP" />

As Jedi investigators grew old or stepped down from their intense assignments, many joined the ranks of the [[Jedi recruiter]]s as members of the [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]], bringing [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] so that they could be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], or solve criminal cases normal police forces were incapable of deciphering.<ref name="TJP" />

In [[3956 BBY]], the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] assigned the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]] to investigate the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the settler [[Calder Nettic]]. Balook asked [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was retraining as a jedi at the Enclave, to aid in his investigation by questioning the suspects. The investigation ultimately concluded that both suspects were guilty of criminal acts in the matter and Bolook detained them under Jedi authority.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jedi Master [[Keelyvine Reus]] was a well known investigator amongst those in the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jedi investigator is a prestige class in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.
